## Final Project: Deploying and Orchestrating Autonomous AI Marketing Agents with OpenClaw on a Digital Ocean Droplet

Course: Marketing Graduate Capstone / AI-Driven Marketing Strategies

## Project Overview

\
Students will deploy a fully functional, 24/7 autonomous OpenClaw AI agent system on a Digital Ocean Droplet following the exact step-by-step guidelines provided (Ubuntu 24.04, 2 vCPU/4 GB RAM recommended, Telegram interface with voice-note support, Anthropic Claude as primary LLM, Firecrawl + Playwright MCP scraping stack, UFW + Tailscale security). You will then build and direct a swarm of specialized marketing agents that perform real-world marketing tasks via simple text or voice commands. The goal is to demonstrate how self-hosted multi-agent AI can automate end-to-end marketing workflows (research → content creation → campaign execution → performance monitoring) while operating persistently in the cloud. Deliverables (due at semester end):

-   Live OpenClaw Droplet (share anonymized IP + access instructions via Tailscale or secure screenshot)

-   Video/transcript demo (3–5 min) of text/voice commands directing agents

-   Full setup report + reflection paper (1,500–2,000 words) on marketing implications, limitations, and ethical considerations

-   GitHub repo or shared folder containing all custom agent configs, skill scripts, and command examples

## Project Objectives

The project directly maps to the provided OpenClaw installation and augmentation guidelines. Each objective is measurable and tied to specific technical + marketing outcomes.

1.  Infrastructure Deployment & Configuration (Setup Mastery)\
    Successfully spin up, secure, and configure a production-ready OpenClaw instance on a Digital Ocean Droplet (including 1-Click or manual install, Node.js 24, onboard wizard with Anthropic API key, Telegram channel with voice-note transcription, Firecrawl as default web_fetch tool + Playwright MCP fallback, UFW firewall rules, and Tailscale VPN/Serve for secure access). The system must run as a systemd daemon 24/7.

2.  Advanced Skill & Tool Integration\
    Install and optimize Firecrawl (with API key) as the primary scraping engine, add Playwright MCP for interactive browser automation, and (optionally) Scrapling for ultra-stealth sites. Configure Firecrawl as the default fallback for any web-related marketing task and verify anti-scrape performance on real marketing sites (e.g., competitor pages, news, social).

3.  Multi-Agent Creation & Orchestration\
    Use OpenClaw’s native agent-building commands (via chat or CLI) to create and configure at least three specialized marketing agents (examples: Market Researcher, Content Creator, Campaign Manager). Demonstrate multi-agent orchestration by having the main Claw agent direct the swarm to complete a complex, end-to-end marketing workflow using persistent memory and heartbeat scheduling.

4.  Marketing Application & Autonomous Execution\
    Design and execute a realistic marketing campaign scenario (e.g., “Research top 3 competitors in [your industry], generate 5 personalized LinkedIn/Twitter posts with images, schedule email outreach, and monitor sentiment”). All actions must be triggered solely via Telegram text or voice notes. Agents must leverage Firecrawl/Playwright for research, Claude for reasoning/creativity, and built-in skills for email/calendar/file/API actions.

5.  Documentation, Reflection & Professional Presentation\
    Produce a professional report that includes full setup logs/screenshots, command examples, demo transcript, cost analysis (Droplet + API usage), ethical discussion (data privacy, AI hallucinations in marketing claims), and strategic recommendations for how marketing teams could adopt similar self-hosted agent swarms.

## Bonus (up to +5 points):

Innovative marketing use case (e.g., real-time sentiment analysis + auto-response on live campaigns, multi-language localization, or integration with external marketing APIs not covered in base guidelines).\
Penalty: Security exposure (public gateway without Tailscale/Funnel password) = automatic 10-point deduction.This project gives you hands-on experience with production-grade autonomous AI while directly applying it to cutting-edge marketing automation. It fulfills every technical requirement in the provided OpenClaw guidelines and positions you to discuss self-hosted AI agents intelligently in job interviews or strategy meetings.

# Final Project: Deploying and Orchestrating Autonomous AI Marketing Agents with OpenClaw on Digital Ocean

**Course:** Marketing Graduate Capstone / AI-Driven Marketing Strategies\
**Instructor:** [Your Name]\
**Due Date:** [Insert Date]\
**Student Name:** [Your Name]\
**Points:** 100 (+5 bonus)

## Project Overview

In this capstone project, you will deploy a production-grade, self-hosted autonomous AI agent system using **OpenClaw** on a Digital Ocean Droplet. OpenClaw turns LLMs (e.g., Anthropic Claude) into action-taking agents that live in chat apps like Telegram and can build/direct swarms of specialized agents.

You will configure the system following official guidelines (Ubuntu 24.04, recommended 2 vCPU/4 GB RAM Droplet, Telegram with voice notes, Anthropic Claude, Firecrawl as default web scraping tool with Playwright MCP fallback, UFW firewall + Tailscale security). Then, build and direct a multi-agent marketing swarm to execute real marketing workflows via simple text or voice commands.

This project demonstrates how self-hosted AI agents can automate end-to-end marketing processes while emphasizing security, cost control, ethics, and strategic business value.

## Learning Objectives

-   Master deployment of persistent, cloud-based autonomous AI agents.
-   Build and orchestrate specialized multi-agent systems for marketing tasks.
-   Apply AI tools (Claude reasoning + Firecrawl scraping) to real marketing research, content, and campaign execution.
-   Analyze practical, ethical, and strategic implications of agentic AI in marketing.

## Technical Requirements (Based on Official OpenClaw Guidelines)

1.  Create a Digital Ocean Droplet (Ubuntu 24.04, 2 vCPU/4 GB RAM recommended).
2.  Install OpenClaw via the official script or 1-Click Marketplace app.
3.  Configure Anthropic API (Claude models), Telegram channel (supporting text + voice notes).
4.  Install and optimize Firecrawl (default web_fetch) + Playwright MCP for robust scraping.
5.  Secure with UFW firewall and Tailscale (preferred) or Tailscale Funnel with strong password.
6.  Ensure the system runs 24/7 as a systemd daemon.

## Project Deliverables

1.  **Live OpenClaw System** — Share anonymized access (Tailscale IP or secure screenshots of status commands). Do **not** expose the gateway publicly without protection.
2.  **Demo Video or Live Transcript** (3–5 minutes) — Show text/voice commands creating agents and executing a full marketing workflow.
3.  **Written Report** (1,500–2,000 words) — Include:
    -   Step-by-step setup documentation with screenshots/logs.
    -   Sample agent creation commands and custom prompts.
    -   Full campaign execution results.
    -   Cost analysis (Droplet + API usage).
    -   Reflection on marketing strategy implications, limitations (hallucinations, rate limits, anti-scrape challenges), and ethics (privacy, consent, transparency in AI-generated content).
4.  **Repository** — GitHub or shared folder with agent configs, custom skills/scripts, and prompt examples.

## Sample Marketing Campaign Scenario (Recommended)

"Research the top 3 competitors in [your chosen industry, e.g., sustainable fashion/coffee/tech tools], generate 5 engaging LinkedIn-style posts with suggested images or data, draft a personalized cold email sequence, and set up basic sentiment monitoring for mentions."

You may propose your own scenario if it demonstrates comparable complexity.

(See separate detailed rubric below or in Excel template.)

**Bonus (up to 5 points):** Innovative extension (e.g., real-time sentiment analysis with auto-response, multi-language support, or integration with external marketing APIs like email tools).

**Penalties:** Security violations (public exposure without protection) deduct 10+ points. Late submissions: 10% per day.

## Important Notes

-   Use your own Anthropic and Firecrawl API keys (free tiers are often sufficient for the project).
-   Prioritize security: Tailscale + UFW is strongly recommended.
-   Document everything — clear logs and explanations earn higher marks.
-   Reflect critically: Discuss how this technology could transform marketing teams vs. current tools (e.g., vs. traditional automation or general-purpose chatbots).

Good luck! This project combines technical deployment skills with high-level marketing strategy thinking.

## 2. Sample Agent Prompts

Here are ready-to-use prompts you can send via Telegram to your OpenClaw main agent. Copy them directly or adapt.Basic Agent Creation:

-   “Create a new specialized agent named Market_Researcher using Claude 3.5 Sonnet. Its workspace is \~/marketing_research. It should use Firecrawl for all web scraping and focus on competitor analysis and trend detection.”

-   “Build a Content_Creator agent that generates professional LinkedIn and Twitter posts. It should suggest image descriptions or data visualizations and use Playwright if interactive elements are needed.”

Orchestration / Campaign Prompts:

-   “Direct the swarm: Have Market_Researcher analyze the top 3 competitors in sustainable coffee brands using Firecrawl. Then have Content_Creator generate 5 LinkedIn posts based on the findings. Finally, have Campaign_Manager draft a 3-email nurture sequence.”

-   “Voice command equivalent (speak this as a voice note): Research current AI marketing trends on the web, summarize key insights, create three engaging Twitter threads, and schedule a follow-up research task for next week.”

Advanced / Troubleshooting Prompts:

-   “Use Firecrawl to scrape the latest pricing from [competitor website] and structure the output as a comparison table.”

-   “Create a Sentiment_Monitor agent that checks mentions of our brand on news sites daily and alerts me on negative sentiment.”

-   “Show me the current status of all agents and skills. Then optimize the researcher agent to avoid rate limits.”

These prompts leverage OpenClaw’s ability to build agents via chat, use persistent memory, and orchestrate multi-agent workflows.3.
